edges.reason: transfer delegates execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
transferFrom requires the result of ensure() before mutating state.
ensure calls condition when the caller is not privileged.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum for the source address.
Source balance is decremented without SafeMath, enabling underflow.
Recipient balance is incremented without SafeMath, enabling overflow.
Allowance is decremented without SafeMath, enabling underflow.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
ensure reads the owner state variable to bypass sale conditions.
ensure reads tradeAddress to bypass sale conditions.
ensure reads canSale to bypass sale conditions.
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition reads _onSaleNum for the source address.
condition reads _minSale as a lower bound on value.
condition reads _maxSale as an upper bound on value.
approveAndCall is gated by a msg.sender == owner authorization check.
approveAndCall sets canSale for the spender address.
approveAndCall mints a balance directly into balanceOf.
approveAndCall scales the minted amount by decimals.
transferownership is gated by an unprotected msg.sender == owner check.
transferownership rewrites the tradeAddress state variable.
Constructor assigns the deployer as owner.
Constructor initializes totalSupply.
Constructor mints the entire supply into the deployer balanceOf.
Constructor assigns the token name.
Constructor assigns the token symbol.
transfer passes msg.sender into transferFrom as the source.
transferFrom relies on msg.sender for allowance and self-transfer authorization.
approveAndCall trusts msg.sender for the ownerOnly authorization check.
transferownership trusts msg.sender for the ownerOnly authorization check.
Constructor sets owner from msg.sender.
msg.sender indexes the allowance entry that is decremented without SafeMath.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter is only meaningful as part of transfer and is forwarded to transferFrom.
The amount parameter is only meaningful as part of transfer and is forwarded to transferFrom.
The source address parameter is used exclusively for allowance checks and balance mutation inside transferFrom.
The recipient parameter is used exclusively for balance mutation inside transferFrom.
The amount parameter drives allowance and balance arithmetic inside transferFrom.
The spender parameter is only used to index the allowance mapping written by approve.
The allowance amount parameter is only stored by approve.
The spender parameter is only used to mint balance and whitelist the address.
The mint amount parameter is only consumed inside approveAndCall.
The address parameter is only assigned to tradeAddress inside transferownership.
The source parameter is only evaluated in ensure's privilege checks.
The destination parameter is only evaluated in ensure's privilege checks.
The value parameter is only forwarded from ensure into condition.
The source parameter is only used to index _onSaleNum inside condition.
The value parameter is only compared against sale thresholds inside condition.
The name parameter is only stored into the name state variable during construction.
The symbol parameter is only stored into the symbol state variable during construction.
The supply parameter is only scaled and stored into totalSupply and balanceOf during construction.
